title: AI engineering, agent practitioners and open-source maintainers
description: Blogs, newsletters and official news feeds from people and labs whose public work shapes coding agents and LLM practice, plus open-source maintainers whose posts affect the tools agents depend on. Feed URLs are given where confirmed; otherwise the publication page is listed with a note.

items.title: Simon Willison's Weblog (everything feed)
items.summary: Daily notes on LLM tools, prompt injection, agent tooling and open-source releases; one of the fastest practitioner sources for new model and tool behaviour.
items.licence: All rights reserved by the author unless stated
items.notes: Feed URL confirmed in search results (an OPML subscription list and a 30 April 2026 post about changes to /atom/everything/) and listed in the Kagi Small Web index.

items.title: OpenAI News RSS
items.summary: Every post on OpenAI's news page: product launches, research, safety updates and company news.
items.licence: OpenAI terms; posts are OpenAI's copyright
items.notes: Feed directories in search results agree on this URL; the older /blog/rss.xml forwards to it.

items.title: Anthropic news (no official feed)
items.summary: Anthropic's announcements page. No native RSS feed was found: feed directories report /news/rss.xml as not found and a July 2026 guide recommends the email subscription.
items.licence: Anthropic terms
items.notes: Check the page directly or subscribe by email; third-party generated feeds (RSSHub routes, Feeder) depend on page layout and can break.
cautions: Do not scrape the page at high frequency; once a day is enough for announcements.

items.summary: AI engineering newsletter and podcast with interviews of people building agents and models.
items.licence: All rights reserved by the publisher
